name: Doorstep Services
description: A platform for customers to register for doorstep services.
project_description:
The DoorstepServices module enables users to register for various service requests and receive notifications about their requests via email. 

 Features 
 The DoorstepServices module enables users to register for various service requests and receive notifications about their requests via email. Users can view, edit, and cancel their own requests if needed. Administrators have the ability to update the status of service requests and generate PDF bills, which are sent via email to both the customer and a copy to the admin's email account. Additionally, administrators can filter service requests based on their status type.

 Post-Installation 
 To register service request got to /doorstep-services/register

To view all requests go to /admin/service-requests

To view customers own requests go to /user-requests

 Additional Requirements 
 Requires SMTP module https://www.drupal.org/project/smtp 

Requires TCPDF https://packagist.org/packages/tecnickcom/tcpdf
